description: Positive control for the ERC and DRC gates: a board with nothing to report, used to prove those gates can pass at all and - once mutated - can fail for the right reason. It opts into no other gate, so it declares no artifacts, archive or release profile.

checks.description: Mandatory options and severities are the validator's, not this board's.

geometry_profile.provenance: only the tolerances the ERC/DRC gates apply

waiver_location_mm.provenance: waiver matching: a finding must be at the coordinate the reviewer approved. One micrometre is below KiCad's own report rounding, so a genuinely relocated finding never matches an old waiver.
